title: The Power of Fasting
verse: While they were serving the Lord and fasting, the Holy Spirit said, “Set apart for me Barnabas and Saul for the work to which I have called them.” Then, after they had fasted and prayed and placed their hands on them, they sent them off.
observation: When it was time to know next steps, the people of God focused on humbling themselves so they could hear God’s direction more clearly. This is one of the main reasons we fast. Fasting causes us to quiet our habits, our addictions, and our appetites, so we can hear the Lord’s direction. If you have a big decision coming up, your anxiety or appetites may often be louder than the leading of the Lord. Therefore, the best thing you can do is to push away from all that. Take some time and focus on humbling yourself before the Lord with fasting. You’ll be surprised at the clarity it brings.
application: What meal could you fast within the next few days? How could you replace your physical food with spiritual food? Give it a shot.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for always being willing to give direction when we humble ourselves enough to listen.
